purpose: Artifacts exported from a TurtlePen run whose SOURCE DOCUMENT IS NOT IN THIS REPOSITORY. They cannot enter artifact-catalog.json, which binds a local .turtlepen.json source to its exports. Listing them here keeps them hash-verified instead of silently ungoverned.
rules: No entry here may claim a local source.
An entry is verified by content hash only; it has no release role and can never gate a release.
Re-deriving one of these with import_svg would produce anonymous artwork paths, not the authoring record, so it must not be catalogued as a source.
origin: Drawn through the hosted MCP server at https://brainn.dev/api/mcp/turtlepen on 2026-08-30; the session state lives server-side.
